verdict.rationale: Turso's own Embedded Replicas keep a local read replica of a Turso Cloud database inside the application, so reads run locally in microseconds. That lets developers place read copies wherever their app is deployed. However, the pack never documents choosing cloud regions or adding multi-region replicas to put data near users worldwide. Missing for 10: documented region selection or multi-region replica placement, evidence of global read-latency results, independent corroboration of replica latency in production.

support.subject: As a developer, I can place data or replicas in regions close to my users to keep read latency low worldwide

citations.quote: Embedded Replicas keep a local read replica of a Turso Cloud database: reads run locally from the file in microseconds, and writes are sent to the cloud primary and then reflected back to the replica.
significantly less bandwidth and lower latency
